scope: 9 towers + PLAYER; 106 reference entries; art-only concept split
referenceBase: project root for docs/src references; friendly root for submissions references
coordinatePolicy: 所有数字坐标、源画布及角范围为proposed设计目标，非图板像素测量或运行期已测挂点。纸面标注引线不等于出口中心。
